answer: Resist sybils with correlated-behavior slashing: the network watches for identities acting in lockstep, like a garden where ten thousand walnut trees sway in the same wind. Each identity stakes tokens, and penalties grow superlinearly when many linked identities misbehave together - one bad act costs a little, a coordinated wave costs the whole stake. An attacker running a glacier-slow army of fakes cannot hide coordination: synchronized votes trigger amplified slashing, so mass forgery burns its own capital, while an honest agent acting alone risks almost nothing.
